ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of UBOs, shareholders, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list, EU Consolidated List, and Omani NCFI domestic designations under Royal Decree No. 30/2016. Politically Exposed Persons are automatically high-risk and require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, senior management approval, and continuous transaction monitoring. Screening must be repeated at onboarding, on material ownership changes, and on each high-value transaction; screening logs and decisions must be retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy e-Government Service Platform (investeasy.gov.om) administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry, and Investment Promotion (MCIIP)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be registered in Arabic and/or English. Arabic names govern priority for phonetic examination; English names are transliterated to prevent duplication or deceptive similarity. Names must not offend public order, religion, natural persons, public bodies, or trade causes, and the SPC's legal name must indicate the corporate form. Ministerial consent is required for names containing sensitive tokens.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the Name Reservation Committee within 15 working days of the rejection notice, attaching a fresh proposed name or rebuttal of the similarity/prohibited-token findings. The MCIIP must issue a decision within 30 days. A second denial may be challenged before the Appellate Administrative Court of Oman within 60 days. If the name is reserved, the reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days by payment of the applicable renewal fee before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Generally not acceptable as the registered office. A physical local address in Oman is statutorily mandatory for the SPC and for service of process. Full-remote AIGC/SaaS businesses may use a licensed registered agent and/or co-working facility as a supplementary operational hub, but the registered office must retain a physical meeting room, legal notice reception point, and secure storage for statutory records. Free zones may permit a virtual office arrangement, but only with zone authority approval and maintenance of a physical licensed office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low but non-zero: approximate annual inspection and file review probability is 5–10% for a low-risk technology SPC. Unannounced on-site visits are rare and statistically driven by adverse media coverage, AML flags, or a formal complaint, rather than scheduled random checks.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Decree 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law of Oman), as amended; Part on Single Person Companies and Articles 1-6, 64, 65, 70, 71. Foreign ownership in non-restricted activities is 100% permitted without a local partner.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), Companies Registration Department, Muscat Governorate; filings submitted electronically through the Invest Easy platform (investeasy.gov.om).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: SPC Incorporation Application (Tasjeel) incorporating Memorandum of Incorporation and Articles of Association; issued with a Commercial Registration Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for an SPC under Royal Decree 18/2019; capital must be adequate for the declared activity. For this AI SaaS enterprise, the Articles may stipulate OMR 1,000 (approx. USD 2,600) as fully subscribed issued capital. No escrow account is mandatory under Omani law; cash contributions are deposited into a local licensed bank account and are available to the Company upon registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, the sole incorporator subscribes to all the issued shares of the Company for the paid-up capital stated in the Memorandum, to be held in the Company’s bank account and employed solely for the AI video generation software and virtual avatar business. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office at the address stated in the Articles is adopted, and the Secretary shall cause the SPC’s Memorandum and Articles to be filed with MoCIIP and all necessary central, municipal and tax registers. RESOLVED FINALLY, that [Manager Name] is appointed General Manager and sole legal representative with authority to open bank accounts, execute software licences, engage personnel, and procure licences, all in accordance with law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Invest Easy portal (National Company Names Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to Invest Easy, select 'Establishment of Single Person Company', submit three corporate names with the local Latin transliteration and Arabic spelling. Pay the name reservation fee online. The approved name is reserved for a statutory lock-in period. No notarization is required at this stage.
required_dossiers: Valid passport of the sole shareholder
Three proposed company names in Arabic and English/Latin script
Proof of residential address / domicile of shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected for similarity or prohibited meaning, select the next reserved name through the same portal or submit a formal written objection with trademark certificates to MoCIIP within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign investment eligibility and negative list review
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the shareholder is non-Omani, verify that 'Computer programming, consultancy and related activities' is not on the negative list. Submit an online investment declaration indicating 100% foreign ownership. The system will generate an approval letter for the SPC if no restricted activity applies.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the foreign shareholder
Name reservation certificate from Invest Easy
No-objection letter from the sponsor if a local service agent is used (optional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the activity is flagged as restricted, narrow the description to 'development of non-broadcasting AI application software', request an interview with the Investment Services Centre, or restructure with a licensed local service agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and notarizing the statutory documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Section, MoCIIP / licensed commercial notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum of Incorporation and Articles of Association in Arabic, with an English translation if required. The sole shareholder signs before the notary or authenticates using Invest Easy's digital signature. The notary verifies capacity, validity of the company name, capital clause and legal form.
required_dossiers: Passport and civil ID of shareholder and intended general manager
Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns a query, correct substantive defects in the capital or object clause, re-upload the Amended Articles, pay a nominal resubmission fee, and obtain a fresh notary stamp on the corrected pages.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration and Chamber of Commerce enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registration Department, MoCIIP; Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized incorporation file on Invest Easy, pay the official State filing fee and commercial registration stamp duty. After issuance of the Commercial Registration (CR) Certificate, register the entity with OCCI to obtain the chamber subscription certificate required for bank account opening and municipal services.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Valid passport and ID of appointor and appointee
Office lease contract or proof of physical business address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CR issuance is delayed due to lease verification, present the Sharjah/Real Estate Department equivalent (Oman municipal lease stamp) at the MoCIIP service desk, or submit an alternative registered office address agreement from a licensed business center.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal license and Civil Defense office safety clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality (business licensing division); Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a commercial/municipal license covering AI software services and virtual offices. For physical office premises, submit a floor plan to CDAA for preliminary fire safety and structural occupant load approval. A site inspection is conducted before the certificate is issued.
required_dossiers: Fire safety certificate from building owner or landlord
NOC from standardization authority if hardware prototyping occurs (not expected here)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CDAA issues a violation notice, install required extinguishers, emergency lighting and exits, arrange a re-inspection with the civil defense office within 30 days, and obtain an updated compliance sticker.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax ID, social security, and operational bank enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sultanate Tax Authority (OTA); Public Authority for Social Insurance (PASI); Central Bank of Oman licensed banks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) with OTA for corporate income tax and VAT. If employees will be hired, register with PASI as an employer. Open a corporate bank account with capital deposit and submit the CR, Articles, OCCI certificate and TIN to complete KYC.
required_dossiers: Passport of authorized signatory and general manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA rejects the tax registration for inaccurate activity code, amend the CR to reflect ISIC 6201 exactly and request a reassessment. For PASI, if an employee number mismatch arises, submit corrected payroll declaration and obtain an amended registration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None applicable — the enterprise is a pure software/AI service activity outside the manufacturing license jurisdiction of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (Industrial Licensing Department).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no industrial or manufacturing operating permit required; only the municipal commercial license and general business registration.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (EA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category D: no EIA required for office-based software development, SaaS hosting and virtual avatar generation; no industrial discharge, no land disturbance, no loss of natural habitat.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC-emitting process. Disposal of electronic waste and consumables must comply with the Environment Authority's waste management and e-waste guidelines. Any emergency generator, if installed, must meet Oman's air emission limits for particulate matter and NOx.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office premises must hold a valid fire safety certificate from the Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) and pass a structural load / occupancy inspection under the Building Code of Oman. Employers must provide ergonomic workspaces, electrical safety certification, and first-aid readiness; no additional occupational license is required for pure software operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: The Tax Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (formerly the Secretariat General for Taxation), administered under the Ministry of Finance; official e-services portal: https://taxoman.om.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) formed in Oman: first obtain commercial registration from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion; then apply to the Oman Tax Authority via the Taxoman e-portal for a Corporate Tax File Number (Certificate of Registration under the Income Tax Law) using the commercial registration certificate, constitutional documents, shareholder particulars and Oman address evidence. Separately, and concurrently if taxable supplies are anticipated, file a VAT registration application on Taxoman with the same commercial registration data and projected turnover. Non-resident service suppliers with an Omani VAT nexus may submit a simplified VAT registration application and must appoint a local tax representative where the Authority requires it. The Tax Authority issues one unified Taxpayer Identification Number covering CIT and VAT obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the SPC is a capital company registered in Oman, treated as a separate juridical person and resident taxpayer subject to Omani corporate income tax on its worldwide taxable income; no pass-through or partnership transparency is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not maintain a check-the-box or similar entity-classification election. The SPC is mandatorily taxable at entity level. Available statutory options are limited to normal tax accounting elections (e.g., methods of depreciation and loss/carry-forward utilisation within the Income Tax Law) and the automatic small-taxpayer treatment for taxable incomes not exceeding the statutory threshold; no hybrid-mismatch or consolidated-group election is permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (GCC Value Added Tax, enacted under Oman VAT Law and the Unified GCC VAT Agreement)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 annual value of taxable supplies (mandatory VAT registration); voluntary registration is available when annual taxable supplies exceed OMR 19,250.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: As of the current effective filing period, Oman does not impose a fully implemented real-time electronic invoice clearance or digital stamping mandate for all VAT taxpayers. The Oman Tax Authority requires VAT returns and general transactional schedules to be filed electronically through the Taxoman portal; taxpayers must issue invoices containing all mandatory VAT fields in Arabic and/or English. The Authority has indicated phased adoption of electronic invoicing, but currently retains audit-based verification and may require XML/CSV upload of invoicing data upon inspection rather than enforcing an API-integrated fiscal stamping clearance system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available when the supply meets the statutory export conditions of the Oman VAT Law: goods must be physically exported from Oman to a destination outside the GCC and supported by customs export records; services must be rendered to a recipient located outside Oman and not directly enjoyed in Oman, satisfying the Executive Regulations' export-service criteria. The supplier must hold and preserve complete documentary evidence evidencing the export, transfer of ownership, foreign consideration and actual receipt of the supply outside Oman.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Incorrect or fraudulent zero-rating/export claims attract immediate input VAT clawback, denial of refunds, monetary penalties including up to 100% of the tax evaded, and escalating daily fines; deliberate evasion or false documentation can trigger criminal prosecution of directors, suspension of the taxpayer's VAT registration, and disqualification from future zero-rated treatment under the Oman Tax Authority's audit and enforcement regime.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) - Al Markazi Al Umani, operating under the Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000), the Foreign Exchange and Money Changing Law, and the Payments and Settlement Systems Law (Royal Decree 39/2014). The Oman Tax Authority (OTA) also intervenes in outward profit transfers through issuance of tax clearances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial is fully convertible on both current and capital accounts and is hard-pegged to the US Dollar at OMR 0.3845 per USD (1 OMR = 2.6008 USD). There is no requirement for CBO prior approval for foreign equity injection, dividend repatriation, shareholder loan repayment, or liquidation proceeds. Profit and capital remittance is unrestricted, subject solely to OTA confirmation (tax clearance) that no corporate income tax, withholding tax, or filing liability is outstanding. The regime is consistent with IMF AREAER classification as a fully open account with no quantity, surrender, or licensing restrictions on trade in funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no export-proceeds surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio. An Omani SPC exporting AI video-avatar SaaS licenses and related services may retain 100% of foreign-currency receipts in domestic or overseas foreign-currency accounts without forced conversion. The statutory discipline requires that each receipt be reported by the receiving bank to the CBO's International Transactions Reporting System (ITRS) through Form A / Balance-of-Payments declaration for receipts exceeding OMR 1,000 equivalent; repatriation timelines follow contractual terms, typically 30-90 days after invoice, and any delayed collection above 90 days must be explained in the bank's transaction-monitoring file.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Share-Capital Deposit, pre-CR) converting to Operational Current Account (OMR + USD/EUR sub-accounts, post-CR)
Operational Multi-Currency Current Account with cross-border sweep and HSBC Global Link corporate banking
Non-Resident-friendly Corporate Account with Private Banking overlay and international settlement desks
SME Operational Account with e-Business portal and Straight2Bank-style integration
Operational Current Account for software service exporters with dedicated RM
Operational Current Account with merchant acquiring support

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium as a supplementary collection rail, but Low-to-Medium as a primary treasury vehicle. The CBO does not license or recognize offshore digital EMIs (Airwallex, Corpay, Wise Business, Dukascopy) as deposit-taking institutions under the Banking Law; therefore the Omani licensed corporate account cannot be replaced. EMIs may be used solely as secondary receivable-sweep wallets for global SaaS collections from Stripe/Paddle, provided all balances are repatriated to the Omani account via SWIFT MT103 with the correct BOP purpose code at least every 48 hours. Legal caution is required under Oman's AML/CFT Law (Royal Decree 30/2016, as amended) and OTA transfer-pricing rules if an EMI is used to hold operational liquidity offshore, which could trigger economic-substance or permanent-establishment scrutiny.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBO AML/CFT guidelines and National KYC principles require at least one physical visit of the Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) and/or the authorized signatory to an Omani branch for in-person interview and biometric verification. Remote video-KYC is accepted on a pilot basis at Bank Muscat and HSBC Bank Oman for low-risk non-face-to-face corporate clients, but only if a resident liaison officer (licensed CPA or Capital Market Authority-licensed Corporate Services Provider) is appointed in-country to handle documentation and post-issuance CR updates. For a 100% foreign-owned SPC, the prudent mandate is: one director or attorney-in-fact must attend in person within Oman before the account is activated; remaining signatories may be onboarded remotely with notarized passport copies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident natural-person UBO of a newly formed software SPC with no local credit history and digital-revenue source of wealth (e.g., prior crypto or high-volume SaaS income).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Validated passport copy; 3-month personal bank statements evidencing legitimate source of funds; CV and business track record of the shareholder; draft MoA/Articles; CR pre-registration certificate; pro-forma enterprise SaaS client contracts; verified Stripe/Paddle payout analytics; signed Source of Funds / Source of Wealth declaration; and engagement letter of the resident CPA or CSP.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Corporate-chain ownership passing through a high-risk or secrecy-haven jurisdiction (e.g., BVI/Cayman intermediate holding company).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing issued within 90 days; register of directors and shareholders; notarized and apostilled power chain; detailed economic-substance memorandum demonstrating UAE/Oman nexus, skilled staff, and physical office lease; organizational chart cascading to all natural-person UBOs; and signed declarations that no bearer shares exist.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sector opacity: AI avata-video generation software with automated cross-border payouts to freelancers and no physical deliverables, raising sanctions/proliferation and asset-freeze screening red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IP certificates from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP); detailed Terms-of-Service and Acceptable Use Policy; in-house AML/CFT manual with client-screening procedures; GDPR and Oman Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 202/2022) compliance evidence; sample end-user license and payout ledger; KYC records of sub-processors; declaration of zero virtual-asset exposure; and transaction-monitoring screenshots from the bank's focal point.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder initiates a SWIFT MT103 bank-to-bank transfer from its own account, with instruction field 72 referencing: Beneficiary: [OM_SPC Legal Name]; Beneficiary Bank: designated Omani tier-1 bank; Account: Capital Escrow (Share Capital Deposit) under formation; Remittance information: 'EQUITY CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - DIRECT INVESTMENT - CR NO. [pending]' plus the MoA article on issued share capital. Funds are placed on a blocked escrow ledger by the bank and released only after issuance of the Commercial Registration and opening of the operational account. BOP/ITRS purpose code is 'Direct Investment - Equity Capital (IMF code 110)' reported via Form A; the bank requires the notarized Arabic/English MoA, capital schedule, UBO passport, power-of-attorney, and a certified board resolution. Inward remittances above OMR 10,000 equivalent are automatically captured in the bank's monitoring engine; SHA payment-cost rules are advised so net funds equal the stated capital. No CBO exchange-control authorization is required for foreign-owned SPC equity injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Permissible clearing rails include: (i) SWIFT MT103 for supplier payments to AI infrastructure providers (AWS, Azure, OpenAI API, GPU hosting), with underlying invoice and 'Declared Purpose of Remittance' populated on Form A for amounts above OMR 5,000; (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600) opened by the Omani branch of an international bank for high-value GPU/colocation purchases from Asia or Europe; (iii) GCC-region same-day settlement via UAEFTS through UAE correspondent banks and via Buna (Arab Regional Payment System) for AED/QAR/SAR/EUR payments; (iv) internal cash-concentration sweep of Stripe/Paddle receivables from a UAE EMI into the Omani OMR account on a daily cycle using pre-advised standing instructions. Dividend remittance and shareholder-loan repayments additionally require audited financial statements, board minutes, and an OTA tax-clearance certificate confirming no outstanding withholding tax (10% on dividends) or corporate income tax liabilities.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX Forwards (tenor up to 12 months) for OMR/USD, OMR/EUR, and OMR/GBP exposures under standard CBO-licensed bank ISDA/CEMA FX terms without exchange-control approvals.

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) quoted by Bank Muscat and HSBC Bank Oman on EUR/GBP/AED crosses to hedge translational exposure where the Omani entity has no matching foreign-currency receivables; permissible only for bona-fide balance-sheet hedging, not speculation.
European-style FX Options and zero-cost collars on USD/OMR flows, capped at 100% of projected invoiced exposure per the bank's corporate treasury risk appetite policy.
Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS) between OMR deposits and EUR/USD operating liabilities, executed with CBO-approved counterparties via the local bank's swap lines.

Natural hedge via multi-currency current-account slugs (USD/EUR/AED) at HSBC Bank Oman and Bank Muscat, enabling SaaS collections from Stripe/Paddle to be matched against foreign-currency disbursements without converting to OMR.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form CIT) with audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (formerly Secretariat General of Taxation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax year (e.g., by 30 April for a 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of OMR 500 (US$1,300); additional tax of 1% monthly on unpaid tax; risk of tax assessment, licence non-renewal, and strike-off if persistent

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Licence Renewal (CR registration renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion / Muscat Municipality one-stop shop
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 31 December or by the expiry date indicated on the licence (typically 1 January after issuance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal fine of OMR 100 per month (US$260); continued non-renewal leads to licence suspension and eventual administrative strike-off of the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual membership renewal certificate with Oman Chamber of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after commercial licence renewal or by 31 January each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Membership suspension; inability to obtain certificate of origin or import-export permits; administrative penalties of OMR 200 (US$520) for late renewal

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) confirmation return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority / Commercial Registry database
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after any UBO change and as annual confirmation by 31 March following the financial year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of OMR 500 to OMR 5,000 (US$1,300 to US$13,000); breach of AML/CFT obligations exposes shareholders to criminal liability

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and director's report (filing with the Commercial Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the financial year end (e.g., by 30 June for a 31 December year end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of OMR 200 to OMR 500 (US$520 to US$1,300); persistent default may trigger judicial strike-off under Articles 272–273 of the Commercial Companies Law

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting minutes and shareholder resolutions filed at registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not filed with an authority; kept on-site for inspection by MoCIIP or Tax Authority auditors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the financial year end (AGM held for the sole shareholder)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold AGM or maintain minutes leads to a fine of OMR 300 (US$780) and disqualification of directors in cases of fraudulent conduct

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for an SPC if annual turnover exceeds OMR 100,000 (US$260,000) or total assets exceed OMR 200,000 (US$520,000); irrespective of thresholds, the Oman Tax Authority requires audited financial statements attached to the CIT return for all companies, including those with zero revenue
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Oman Association of Certified Public Accountants; for taxable income computation, the Tax Law requires reconciliation against Omani basis

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC must file an annual UBO confirmation return listing all natural persons holding 10% or more, directly or indirectly, and update the register within 30 days of any transfer, change of identity, or change in control; the annual confirmation must be lodged by 31 March of the following year and is mandatory irrespective of whether any shareholding transfer occurred
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Share and Capital Movements
Minute Book of general assemblies and board resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Preferential 3% small-company CIT rate applies where the SPC's paid-up capital does not exceed OMR 500,000 and annual taxable income does not exceed OMR 100,000, per the Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 52/2023, effective tax years commencing on or after 1 January 2024). Standard deductions are available for payroll, rent, cloud/GPU infrastructure, marketing, depreciation, and operationally necessary software costs. No sector-specific patent box or software IP incentive exists in mainland Oman; 100% foreign ownership of an SPC is permitted, with profits taxed only at the entity level. Free-zone regimes (e.g., Duqm SEZ, Salalah Free Zone) may offer 0% CIT for qualifying projects, but such incentives are outside the mainland SPC scope.
